name: link
title: Link
summary: Takes people somewhere. Inline in a sentence, or standalone in navigation.
use: standalone in mastheads, footers and lists of destinations.
anatomy: A 1px underline at 40% of the text color (inline only)

options.name: variant
options.description: standalone has no underline until hover and a 44pt target.

options.name: external
options.description: Opens in a new tab on the web and in the browser in apps.

rules: Links keep the text color; the accent never colors a link.
accessibility: The words describe the destination on their own.
